learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn magical words that tell us more about our friends, toys, and everything around us!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Look at a big red apple. Do you see how I used the words big and red to tell you about the apple? These magic words make our stories so much fun!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Color words and shape words are describing words. They tell us how things look. A ball is round. The sun is yellow. Is your shirt blue?
Some words tell us the size of things. Is it a big elephant or a small mouse? Size words are describing words too!
How does your teddy bear feel? It feels soft! Are you a happy child? Words about feelings and touch are also describing words.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ Which word describes the color of the sky?
❓ What kind of animal is an elephant?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 🕵️‍♀️ Toy Detective!
fun_activity.instructions: Hide your favourite toy behind your back. Give your mommy or daddy three describing words about it so they can guess what it is!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Describing words tell us more about naming words.
⭐ Words for colors, sizes, shapes, and feelings are all describing words!
